snippet.title: FEEDSTOCK - 4-Player Co-op Horror Trailer | The Loot Goes Inside the Monster
snippet.description:
Four drones, one night shift, and a thing that eats everything you carry
out. Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5154830/FEEDSTOCK

FEEDSTOCK is a 4-player online co-op horror game. You play maintenance
drones. Everything you carry out of the house goes inside the thing that
pays you, and it grows with every meal, until it no longer fits through
the door you came in by.

- 4-player online co-op horror with proximity voice chat
- the loot does not go in a backpack, it goes inside her, and she grows
- 12 houses, 28 tenants that lived there before you
- carry blind: the cargo sits in front of your camera
- the quota is not negotiable, and neither is she

If you play Lethal Company, R.E.P.O. or Content Warning with the same three
people every night, this one is for those three people.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5154830/FEEDSTOCK
Join the Discord: https://discord.gg/MRhbPFpuM
Coming 2026.

#coophorror #horrorgame #indiegame #gameswithfriends
